obligations.description: When the screen loads it shows 'Izaberite kategoriju' in the right panel.
Tap a category name (e.g. 'Deserti') to load its recipes, then tap a recipe name link: 'Izaberite kategoriju' and the category list entry 'Deserti' are no longer shown.
Tapping a category name (e.g. 'Deserti') shows recipes belonging to that category and hides 'Izaberite kategoriju'.

intentionalDifferences.reason: The empty-category state depends on which category has no recipes in the live data; cannot be guaranteed to exist during tests.

obligations.description: With no recipes marked as favorite the screen shows 'Nemate omiljenih recepata'.

When at least one favorite recipe card is shown, tapping its recipe name link leaves the favorites screen ('Nemate omiljenih recepata' or another favorites-only element is no longer shown). Note: adding a favorite requires the recipe detail screen; this obligation relies on pre-existing favorites in the data or a flow.
Tapping 'Dodaj sastojke u listu za kupovinu' shows 'Sastojci su dodati u listu za kupovinu'.
Tapping 'Nazad na recepte' leaves the detail page ('Nazad na recepte' is no longer shown).
Tap 'Povećaj porcije' once to have more than 1 serving, then tap 'Smanji porcije': the servings count decreases by 1.
Tapping 'Povećaj porcije' increases the displayed servings count and scales the ingredient amounts shown.
Opening a recipe detail page (e.g. navigating from the recipe list by tapping 'Sarma') shows the recipe name 'Sarma', its category, time, difficulty, rating, and calories in the header.
Tapping a category filter button (e.g. 'Deserti') shows only recipes in that category; recipes from other categories (e.g. 'Sarma') are no longer shown.
Tapping a recipe name link (e.g. 'Sarma') leaves the list ('Pretraga' is no longer shown).
Typing 'zzznema' in 'Pretraga' shows 'Nema recepata za zadatu pretragu'.
Typing 'Sarma' in 'Pretraga' shows only the recipe 'Sarma' and hides other recipes.

intentionalDifferences.reason: Ingredients tooltip appears on mouse hover (onMouseEnter/onMouseLeave); touch screens have no hover. Ingredients are shown on the recipe detail screen.
Sorting only changes the order of rows; a test cannot check order.

obligations.description: Filling 'Namirnica' with 'Mleko' and tapping 'Dodaj' shows 'Mleko' in the list and the footer shows 'Kupljeno: 0 od 1'.
Fill 'Namirnica' with 'Mleko', tap 'Dodaj', check 'Mleko', then tap 'Obriši kupljene': 'Mleko' is no longer shown in the list.
With no items added the screen shows 'Lista za kupovinu je prazna'.
Fill 'Namirnica' with 'Mleko', tap 'Dodaj', then fill 'Namirnica' with 'Hleb', tap 'Dodaj': checking 'Mleko' (the checkbox labeled 'Mleko') marks it as bought and the footer shows 'Kupljeno: 1 od 2'.

flows.description: On the recipe detail page tap the favorite button for a recipe, then navigate to '/omiljeni': the recipe card is shown in the favorites list.
On a recipe detail page tap 'Dodaj sastojke u listu za kupovinu', then navigate to '/kupovina': the recipe's ingredients appear in the shopping list.
On the categories screen tap a category name, then tap a recipe name: the detail screen shows that recipe's name and metadata.
With at least one favorite, on the favorites screen tap a recipe name card link: the detail screen shows that recipe's name and metadata.
On the recipe list tap a recipe name (e.g. 'Sarma'): the detail screen shows 'Sarma' and its metadata.
